concept: A premium editorial papercraft scene of an institutional securities offering: a precise central investor-register ledger and four distinct architectural entrances into a miniature financial district. Ivory paper, forest green, crimson accents, realistic brass details. Focus on choosing an operating route, not speculative wealth.
altDescription: Illustrative paper financial district with an investor register and four issuance routes.
